meta.title: Fetch chain
meta.description: Adds the "Fetch chain" web fetch provider. Choose it under Settings > Web search and fetch > Web fetch provider. Each web_fetch tries plain HTTP first, then scrape.do, Scrapfly, and Firecrawl in order until one succeeds; a 403, 429, 5xx, timeout, challenge page, unsupported or oversized content, or a service rejection moves to the next step, while 404 and 410 are returned as-is. The result starts with the step that answered, such as "Scrape.do:". Paid services spend credits and receive every URL that reaches them, including intranet URLs. Store keys as SCRAPEDO_API_KEY, SCRAPFLY_API_KEY, and FIRECRAWL_API_KEY in the DSH credentials file or the environment; a service without a key is skipped. Change order, on/off, timeouts, and rendering options in this plugin's settings. Raise tool-web fetchTimeoutMs to 120000 so the default step timeouts fit.
